prompt:
Summarize this external code review in 1-3 concise sentences. Focus on WHAT the reviewer wants changed, not boilerplate. Strip tool share links, HTML tags, promotional text.

## Inline Code Comments
- deploy/openbao/policies/push-app-credentials.hcl:12: **Write-only policy breaks ESO PushSecret reconciliation**

ESO's PushSecret controller does not only perform one-shot writes — on every reconciliation cycle it first **reads** the current value at the remote path to decide whether the secret is already up-to-date before writing. Without `read` capability, every reconciliation after the initial write will receive a `403 permission denied` from OpenBao, and the PushSecret will be stuck in a perpetual `SecretSyncedError` state.

The same issue applies to `push-ceph-keys.hcl` at line 9–11 (`kv-v2/data/ceph/*`).

Both policies need a `read` capability to allow ESO's reconciliation loop to function correctly:

```suggestion
path "kv-v2/data/openstack/*/app-credential" {
  capabilities = ["create", "update", "read"]
}
```

And in `deploy/openbao/policies/push-ceph-keys.hcl`:
```hcl
path "kv-v2/data/ceph/*" {
  capabilities = ["create", "update", "read"]
}
```

The documentation comment "These are write-only policies" in `docs/reference/infrastructure/openbao-bootstrap.md` (line ~380) will also need updating to reflect the added `read` capability.
